response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avgs, AVG(g.n_telescopes) AS avg_of_group_counts FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS n_telescopes FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) g;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with a NULL weathprofile on their observatory form their own group and are kept, since the request does not say to drop them.

Telescopes with NULL pointaccarc are excluded by the strict > 4.86 filter. Missing bandusagepct values are skipped by AVG within each group, and groups whose bandusagepct values are all missing drop out of the outer average. Group counts include every telescope in the group, whatever its bandusagepct.

alternatives.interpretation: Drop groups whose weather profile is missing, treating a NULL weathprofile as not a valid grouping category.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avgs, AVG(g.n_telescopes) AS avg_of_group_counts FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS n_telescopes FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 AND o.weathprofile IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) g;
